name: CASC-J12
description: The CADE ATP System Competition (CASC) is the annual evaluation of fully automatic, classical logic, automated theorem proving (ATP) systems—the world championship for such systems. CASC-J12 was the 29th competition in the CASC series. Nineteen ATP systems competed in the various divisions. This paper presents an outline of the competition design and a commentated summary of the results.
evaluation_method: task_success_rate / problems_solved within time/resource limits (competition-style scoring)
notes: Not a conventional ML dataset — a competition measuring ATP systems on formal-logic problems; results vary strongly by division, problem selection, and engine heuristics.
